subject: Sierra Health: VPC deployment + audit access & pricing asks
messages:
From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@sierrahealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@sierrahealth.com, tom.ruiz@sierrahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private VPC deployment + audit access request

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Sierra Health is very interested in a Private/VPC deployment for our patient-facing NLP workloads. Before we move forward we need confirmation on three items so we can get internal procurement buy-off:

- Data residency: All PHI-derived artifacts must remain within US regions and not be replicated outside our designated cloud account.
- Audit access: We require the ability to run an annual security audit and have an approved third-party auditor review relevant logs and configurations — ideally a remote session with read-only access to audit artifacts or a scheduled extract.
- Commercial: Given the scope and a 36-month committed term, we are requesting a 20% platform fee discount and some concession on the standard audit SOW fee.

I attached a short requirements summary. Can you confirm what’s feasible and any timelines/costs?

Best,
Emily
Emily Santos
Director, Clinical IT & Innovation
Sierra Health

Attachment: sierra_req_20261114.pdf (1 page — summary of residency and audit asks)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private VPC deployment + audit access request — need counsel + pricing

Team — forwarding Sierra Health's asks. Key points to triage: residency (US-only), third-party audit access (remote), requested 20% discount for 36m commit.

Immediate questions:
- Legal: what level of live access can we reasonably allow? Are scheduled extracts + auditor NDA sufficient?
- Infra/SE: technical constraints for providing remote read-only audit access to logs/configs for a third-party auditor; KMS/HSM integration for customer-managed keys?
- Sales: what discount/terms can Deal Desk sign off on before an exec approval is required?

Customer timeline: procurement needs written confirmation by EOD Friday (11/20). I've attached their reqs.

Jordan
Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Attachment: sierra_req_20261114.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment + audit access request — legal perspective

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the ping. High-level legal stance and suggested redlines:

1) Audit access: We should avoid granting unfettered live access into customer environments. Recommended approach:
   - Require an executed Auditor NDA and an approved scope (list of log types, time window, and read-only constraints).
   - Offer either (A) scheduled remote session where we present the requested logs via screen share and provide read-only extracts, or (B) a limited, time-boxed remote access session to a bastion with strict RBAC and monitoring, only at Redwood’s site engineers' supervision.
2) Data residency: We can contractually commit to US-only residency for customer data in their dedicated VPC, with the caveat that backups and DR must be within the US region set in SOW.
3) Commercial concession: We cannot approve a flat 20% platform discount at my level without deal desk input. I suggest we propose a structured concession: 12% platform discount + a separate audit SOW cap. Any live-access concession should be contingent on an SOW and liability carveouts.

I'll draft redline language for inclusion in the SOW and a short addendum that covers audit procedures.

— Lauren
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment + audit access request — engineering constraints

Quick technical notes:

- Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) is supported in Dedicated/Private deployments; we can integrate with their key provider but HSM-backed escrow and on-site HSM appliances require an SOW and security review.
- Providing a live read-only session into a customer VPC is operationally risky (exposes support tooling and escalation paths). We can do:
   * Scheduled remote audit sessions where SE exports the requested logs and provides an immutable extract (S3 export) plus tamper-evident checksums.
   * Or, a monitored bastion with time-limited credentials and full session recording (higher engineering & security overhead).
- Estimated marginal SOW for audit-support options: remote extract path ~= $12k one-time; bastion + session recording path ~= $45k one-time plus quarterly review fees.

I'll prepare a short SOW estimate spreadsheet — attaching a preliminary estimate.

— Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_sow_estimate.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T13:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC deployment + audit access request — pricing ask & next steps

All — thanks for the quick turn. Sierra is a priority logo and the ACV upside is significant, but we need an approval path. My suggested negotiation position:

- Platform discount: offer 15% for a 36-month committed term, subject to exec approval.
- Audit: offer the remote extract (12k) or bastion (45k) as billable SOW; reduce the SOW to $6k for the first year as a one-time concession (marketing / strategic discount) if they accept a 15% platform discount.
- Residency: contractual commitment to US-only is fine with the SOW caveats Lauren called out.

Can I get an exec quick-approval to present 15% + $6k first-year audit SOW concession with legal-approved audit controls? Customer needs confirmation by 11/20.

Marissa
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T15:44:00-08:00
Subject: Request for Exec Sign-off: Sierra Health deal – proposed concessions

Vivek —

Summary and ask: Sierra Health requests US-only residency, third-party audit capability, and a 20% discount request for a 36-month term. Team recommends the following commercial/controls bundle to present to customer:

- Platform discount: 15% (for 36m committed term) — requires your approval to offer.
- Audit support: provide remote extract pathway (one-time SOW). First-year SOW discounted to $6k (normally $12k).
- Access controls: legal to add auditor NDA + approved scope; engineering to do scheduled exports or supervised bastion sessions.
- Conditions: any live access or bastion sessions must be scheduled with Redwood engineers and logged; liability limited to standard contract caps; additional audit frequency or on-site work billable.

If you approve, Marissa will present this to procurement today and we will get them to sign the SOW addendum.

Proposed approval language (copy/paste for your reply):
"I approve offering Sierra Health a 15% platform discount for a 36-month committed term, alongside a one-time $6k discounted audit SOW for year one, subject to the legal-approved auditor NDA and the SOW's operational controls. Any live-access requests beyond scheduled, supervised sessions require a separate SOW and are billable."

Jordan

(Please reply with quick yes/no or edits)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T17:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request for Exec Sign-off: Sierra Health deal – proposed concessions

Jordan / Marissa —

Approve with modifications:

- Discount: approve up to 12% platform discount for 36 months (not 15%). Keep the pricing guardrail — we need to protect unit economics for on-prem customers; if they want 15% we should trade deeper SOW revenue or a larger committed ACV.
- Audit SOW: approve the $6k first-year discount for the remote extract option. Any bastion/live-access requests must be scoped into a separate SOW at the higher estimate and require security sign-off.
- Conditions: require a signed Auditor NDA and 90-day notice for any audit execution. Any deviation from the agreed scope is billable and requires Deal Desk re-approval.

Jordan — please push this to Sierra with the modified concession and get procurement to accept the Auditor NDA and 90-day notice term. Marissa — capture updated pricing in HubSpot and flag for revenue ops to include the audit SOW as a billed item.

— Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
